newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil FDI at $280 mln between July 1-11.
newsitem.headline: Brazil FDI at $280 mln between July 1-11.

text.p: Foreign direct investment into Brazil was $280 million between July 1-11, a Central Bank official said.
Altamir Lopes, head of the bank's economics department, said those inflows did not include any privatization receipts.

Lopes noted a further large sum of foreign direct investment was expected this month because of the $2.45 billion bid by a BellSouth Corp and Banco Safra-led consortium to run Band B cellular services in metropolitan Sao Paulo.
